amount.description: Amount to capture in cents. Must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to the authorized amount. If not provided, the full authorized amount will be captured. 1000 is $10.00

is_final.description: If true, marks this capture as the final one for the payment. Omitting 'amount' always captures the full remaining capturable amount; sending 'amount': 0 with 'is_final' true instead releases the remaining authorization without capturing additional funds. Defaults to false.
